buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (GTC) AND BID SUBMISSION GUIDELINES The Bidder shall strictly comply with the following General Terms & Conditions, GeM General Terms & Con ditions (GTC), and all bid submission guidelines specified on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Portal a nd in the tender document. 1. Compliance with GeM General Terms & Conditions The Bidder shall strictly adhere to all applicable GeM GTC provisions, bid conditions, and submission instru ctions. Any deviation or non-compliance may result in rejection of the bid. The Buyer may separately attac h a detailed list of applicable GeM conditions, wherever required. 2. Rights of the Buyer The Buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, cancel the tender either partially or comple tely, or amend/modify the tender conditions at any stage without assigning any reason.

3. Delivery Schedule and Conduct - All deliveries shall be made only on working days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and declared public holi days. - The Bidder's personnel shall maintain professional conduct at the Buyer's premises. - Smoking, consumption of alcohol, and unnecessary loitering within the Buyer's premises are strictly prohi bited. 4. Material Quality and Replacement Restrictions - No alteration, substitution, or downgrade of the quoted or approved material shall be permitted. - Any replacement item must strictly comply with OEM standards and approved technical specifications. - The Bidder shall upload appropriate documentary evidence confirming compliance of the replacement ite m. 5. Price Quotation and Commercial Conditions - All quoted prices shall be unconditional and inclusive of applicable taxes, duties, transportation, freight, a nd delivery charges. - Prices shall be quoted exclusively in the Financial Bid section of the GeM Portal. - Disclosure or mention of prices in the Technical Bid shall result in disqualification of the bid. 6. Technical Compliance and Execution Methodology - The Bidder shall strictly comply with all technical specifications and requirements mentioned in the tende r document. - The Technical Bid shall include the required methodology, workflow, execution plan, compliance certifica tes, quality assurance plans, and declarations. - A detailed working methodology along with a process flow diagram explaining the proposed bid executio n process must be uploaded with the Technical Bid. 7. Bid Securing Declaration and Conflict of Interest The Bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: - A duly signed Bid Securing Declaration accepting penal action in case of withdrawal, modification, or failu re to execute the contract, as applicable. - A self-declaration confirming that there is no conflict of interest or prohibited relationship with the Tender ing Authority. 8. Bid Evaluation Criteria - Evaluation shall be based on completeness of documents, technical compliance, commercial responsiven ess, and price competitiveness. - Clarifications or shortfall documents may be sought only in respect of pre-existing credentials, wherever permitted. - No new credentials or documents created after the bid submission date shall be accepted. - Only complete and properly submitted bids shall be considered for evaluation. - Incomplete, conditional, or altered bids may be rejected. 9. Bid Submission Deadline The GeM Portal server time shall be considered the final and authoritative reference for bid submission de adlines. Bidders must ensure successful submission of their bids before the prescribed closing date and ti me. 10. Integrity, Ethical Conduct and Legal Status Declaration

- The Bidder shall maintain the highest standards of integrity and ethical conduct throughout the bidding p rocess and contract execution. - The Bidder shall not engage in any corrupt, fraudulent, collusive, coercive, or unethical practices. - A duly signed Integrity Pact shall be submitted along with the bid. - The Bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on ₹100/- Non-Judicial Stamp Paper declaring that: 1. The Bidder is not insolvent. 2. The Bidder has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department, PSU, or Statutory Au thority. 3. The Bidder is not undergoing liquidation or bankruptcy proceedings as on the date of bid submission. Non-submission of the above documents or submission of false information may result in bid rejection and further action under GeM GTC and applicable laws. 11. GST Anti-Profiteering Compliance The Seller shall ensure complete pricing transparency and compliance with applicable GST Anti-Profiteerin g provisions. A duly signed self-declaration confirming compliance with the relevant provisions shall be su bmitted along with the Technical Bid. 12. Monitoring of GeM Portal and Tender Updates - Bidders shall regularly monitor the GeM Portal for updates, amendments, corrigenda, and clarifications. - All official communications, corrigenda, and clarifications shall be published on the GeM Portal. - The Bidder shall be responsible for reviewing and complying with all such updates. 13. Review of Tender Documents and Clarifications - Bidders must carefully review the complete tender notice, specifications, terms and conditions, and other related documents before submitting their bids. - Any clarification sought by the Buyer during the evaluation process shall be submitted in writing within th e stipulated time. - Post-bid modifications or changes to the submitted offer shall not be permitted. - Any amendment or corrigendum published on the GeM Portal shall be duly acknowledged and complied with by the Bidder. - All bid documents shall be prepared strictly in accordance with the prescribed tender schedule and appro ved/standard formats. 14. Document Scanning, Submission and Validity - All scanned documents should preferably be in PDF format, in black and white, with a minimum resolutio n of 100 DPI, ensuring proper readability. - All specified warranties and guarantees shall be clearly documented and submitted along with the bid. - Bids submitted by Sellers whose GeM registration for the quoted item has expired shall not be considered unless renewal has been applied for within the validity period, wherever applicable. 15. Technical Committee Evaluation - The Technical Committee shall evaluate bids based on eligibility criteria, technical compliance, commerci al requirements, and production capacity, wherever applicable. - Technical deviations shall be classified as minor or major. - Bids involving major deviations from the prescribed technical specifications or essential tender conditions shall be rejected. - All bid documents must be duly signed by the authorized signatory.

- Any corrections, overwriting, or modifications in the documents must be properly authenticated with the i nitials of the authorized signatory. 16. GeM Incident Management Policy Declaration The Bidder shall submit a declaration confirming that there are no ongoing incidents or violations against t he Bidder under the GeM Incident Management Policy, as applicable. Submission of false or misleading information may attract penalties and other actions as per applicable Ge M rules. 17. Technical Presentation and Demonstration - The Buyer reserves the right to request technical presentations, product demonstrations, inspections, or additional information from the Bidder during the evaluation process. - Failure to provide satisfactory demonstrations or meet the Buyer's requirements may result in disqualific ation. - All expenses related to bid preparation, product demonstrations, inspections, presentations, and related activities shall be borne entirely by the Bidder. 18. Damage, Defect and One-to-One Replacement In case any supplied item is found damaged, defective, or unfit for use for any reason whatsoever, the Sell er shall provide a one-to-one replacement of the affected item free of cost, without any financial liability to the Buyer. The replacement item shall: - Be brand new and unused. - Strictly comply with the tender specifications. - Meet the approved OEM standards and quality requirements. The Seller shall submit a duly signed self-certification/undertaking along with the bid, confirming acceptan ce of the above conditions. Failure to submit the undertaking may result in rejection of the bid. 19. Termination Due to Insolvency The Buyer reserves the right to terminate the contract without any compensation or liability if the Seller be comes insolvent during the contract period. 20. Extension of Delivery Period and Liquidated Damages The Buyer may extend or re-fix the original delivery period without imposing Liquidated Damages (LD), su bject to the following circumstances: - Force Majeure conditions as specified in the applicable contract terms. - Delays attributable to the Buyer or Consignee. Such extensions shall be subject to the applicable GeM GTC and contractual provisions. 21. Termination of Contract for Default If the Seller fails to fulfil its contractual obligations within the stipulated Delivery Period/Date, such failure shall constitute a breach of contract. In such circumstances, the Buyer shall have the right to: 1. Cancel or withdraw the contract for the unsupplied portion after expiry of the original, extended, or re-fix ed delivery period.

2. Forfeit the Performance Security, wherever applicable. 3. Initiate further action, including downgrading the Seller's rating. 4. Recommend or impose debarment of the Seller from GeM for a specified period, as decided by GeM on t he merits of the case. All such actions shall be governed by the applicable GeM GTC and relevant contractual provisions. . 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
